records.title: The Goa Agricultural Produce and Livestock Marketing (Promotion and Facilitation) (Amendment) Act, 2026
records.text: This Act amends the Goa Agricultural Produce and Livestock Marketing (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2007, including provisions concerning agriculturists, registration, voting, and marketing boards.
